text:
incident-bot: [PAGERDUTY] page fired: infra.autoscaler.queue_backlog.high in inference-prod-us-west. queue_length=12987, 95p_latency_tokens=2.4s, error_rate=1.2% — triggered by queue-length > 8000 for 3m. paging: oncall-eng
emma-lau: acked (emma-lau) — I'm on it. quick summary pls if anyone saw prior changes?
rafael-garcia: saw a large training-batch job finish ~20m ago that freed up some pods but also consumed spare GPU quota earlier. autoscaler logs show repeated FailedScaleUp attempts.
emma-lau: checking HPA/CA now: `kubectl -n inference get hpa,deployment -l app=inference -o wide`
emma-lau: HPA metrics API is returning errors: `no metrics returned from resource metrics API` and HPA desired=0 -> current=0 which is wrong given queue.
priya-singh: customers impacted: 3 high-traffic tenants routed to us-west canary pool. latency spikes and some 5xx for non-timeout requests. recommend rerouting non-critical traffic to inference-prod-eu or fallback variant.
emma-lau: cluster events showing repeated errors:
```
Warning  FailedScaleUp  3m (x12 over 18m)  cluster-autoscaler  failed to scale up: NoCapacity: Insufficient nvidia.com/gpu
```
emma-lau: attempted manual nodepool create to buy breathing room: `gcloud container node-pools create temp-gpu --cluster=prod-us-west --accelerator=type=nvidia-t4,count=1 --zone=us-west1-a --num-nodes=1`
emma-lau: command failure:
```
ERROR: (gcloud) RESOURCE_QUOTA_EXCEEDED: Quota 'GPUS' exceeded for project 12345 in region us-west1.
```
pagerduty-bot: Incident created: PD#INC-7890 (severity: high). Escalation policy initiated: oncall -> eng-lead -> infra. Current assignee: emma-lau.
sarah-nguyen: if quota blocks new nodes we should fallback: 1) enable cpu-quantized variant for lower-priority traffic, 2) scale down batch/low-priority jobs consuming GPUs, 3) start draining ephemeral long-running dev workloads. I can help flip routing.
priya-singh: I've prepared a quick route policy in the control plane to shift 40% of canary traffic to eu region and 30% to cpu-fallback — want me to apply?
emma-lau: apply the routing change. also we'll mark affected customers in the incident as degraded. command I'll run: `rwdctl traffic patch --cluster prod-us-west --service inference-svc --route-weight "eu=0.4,cpu-fallback=0.3,us-west=0.3"`
priya-singh: applying now.
( :spinner: )
priya-singh: done — weights updated. I also bumped priority on some internal batch jobs: `kubectl -n batch scale --replicas=0 cron-batch-heavy`
rafael-garcia: confirming service variants exist: `inference-cpu-q4` is ready in eu and has healthy readiness probes. good to route.
emma-lau: started a controlled deployment to enable cpu fallback in us-west for lowest-priority routes: `kubectl -n inference set env deploy/inference-svc ENABLE_CPU_FALLBACK=true --record` — rollout started.
sarah-nguyen: key customer impact: three tenants see increased p95 latency ~+1.3s, sporadic 503s for heavy requests. alerting on SLO page. I'll update support playbook.
emma-lau: backlog trending down: queue_length=7,200 after routing and fallback (~12m). still above normal threshold but improving.
pagerduty-bot: Escalation: infra lead notified (rafael-garcia) — 10m until next escalation if no ack.
rafael-garcia: taking handoff from emma. I'll own the remainder. first actions: open support quota ticket with cloud provider, request temporary GPU quota bump, and start cleanup of leftover ephemeral GPU nodes used by batch jobs.
emma-lau: opening follow-up tickets: INFRA-2024 (cloud gpu quota request), OPS-1456 (runbook: autoscaler failed scaleup play). adding notes about tuning alert thresholds to reduce noise.
rafael-garcia: quota ticket created with provider ref: Case#CLOUD-9921, requesting +10 T4 GPUs in us-west1, ETA 4-6 hours (requested expedited).
priya-singh: monitoring metrics: error_rate down to 0.4%, 95p_latency_tokens 1.6s, queue_length=1,900. still degraded but functional.
emma-lau: handoff note for next on-call (sarah): please monitor the quota reply and don't merge autoscaler PRs until we confirm knob changes. I'll stay until backlog <1k and then handoff.
sarah-nguyen: acked (sarah-nguyen). I'll monitor dashboards and customer slack. will also coordinate with sales for affected tenants.
rafael-garcia: summary of mitigation: 1) traffic redistribution to eu + cpu fallback applied, 2) scaled down non-critical batch jobs, 3) attempted nodepool creation blocked by quota, 4) provider ticket opened. Impact: degraded latency and some 5xx for heavy requests, no data loss. Next steps: follow through on quota request, revert traffic once capacity confirmed, post-incident runbook + tune alert thresholds.
emma-lau: final update at 00:12 UTC: backlog=600, p95=1.4s, error_rate=0.2%. marking this thread as mitigated but degraded — will convert to incident postmortem.
rafael-garcia: oncall handoff to sarah at 00:30 UTC. I'll remain reachable.
emma-lau: filing postmortem stub: PM-INC-7890. assigning owners: quota request (rafael-garcia), runbook update (emma-lau), customer communications (sarah-nguyen).
sarah-nguyen: thanks all — good triage. follow-up items in INFRA-2024 and OPS-1456.
(thumbsup emoji reactions from several participants)
